jobs.prompt: A hand-drawn science fiction comic book panel, ink linework and flat cel-shaded colour, not a 3D render, not a photograph. An empty background plate of the small open-air courtyard café at night: wooden tables and chairs standing on stone paving, a long rectangular wooden table in the middle, a shade tree hung with strings of little warm lights, low buildings with glowing pink and cyan windows, a dark metal street gate, megastructures towering above the rooftops. The view: from the east end of the long table, looking back west toward the shade tree and the west side. Picture 1 is a depth map of this exact scene rendered from a 3D model (near is light, far is dark): follow its camera position, angle, lens and perspective exactly, and put every wall, table, chair, railing, tier and walkway exactly where and as big as its shape stands there; draw nothing grey from it, it is only the structure. Picture 2 is only a small swatch of colour and material samples from this place: take its colours, materials and light, never its layout. No letters, no glyphs, no writing in any window or neon. Nobody at all: no people anywhere, not at the tables, not in the seats, not on the walkway, not in the street; every chair and seat is empty. Tables stand on the floor and chairs stand on the floor, at their real size. One single continuous picture filling the whole frame. Fully coloured and lit, never grey. Detailed science fiction comic art at night: precise fine uniform linework, cel-shaded flat color, a deep blue and violet night with glowing practical lights, pools of warm and cool light on faces and surfaces, crisp silhouettes, clear readable faces and hands. Wherever the sky shows, enormous megastructures and towering buildings fill the far distance and the horizon, their lit windows and beacons glowing against the night, rich mechanical and architectural detail kept to the middle and far distance. Another time and place, not the Earth we know: unfamiliar architecture, no recognisable landmarks, vehicles or brands. Shop fronts and walls carry no lettered signs at all: at most a plain glowing panel with one single large simple pictogram (a cup, a leaf, a bowl) and nothing else. Screens show only abstract shapes. No letters, words, digits or numbers anywhere. No text, no lettering, no writing, no logos, no numbers. No cartoon murals or cartoon animals, and nothing that resembles a known character. Draw it as a finished comic panel: inked outlines on every shape, painted flat colour, glowing lights.
